premise.coldViewerWhyCare: Gummy supplement users want to know whether their doses are accurately labeled.
premise.viewerQuestion: Does the melatonin amount in gummies match the label?
premise.earlyPayoff: 22 of 25 sampled products were outside plus or minus ten percent.

beats.narration: What if your melatonin gummies don't contain the dose on the label?
beats.onScreenText:
WHAT'S REALLY IN YOUR
MELATONIN GUMMIES?
beats.visualPurpose: Make the personal stakes of an inaccurate label instantly clear.
beats.visualAction: Split the gummy silhouette from its dose label at the word dose.

beats.narration: A lab study found that twenty-two of twenty-five sampled products were more than ten percent off their labeled melatonin amount.
beats.visualPurpose: Lead with the quantitative answer as a memorable large-number comparison.
beats.visualAction: Light 22 cells of a 25-cell laboratory sample grid precisely as the number is spoken.

beats.narration: Among gummies with detectable melatonin, measured amounts ranged from seventy-four to three hundred forty-seven percent of the label.
beats.visualPurpose: Show the range using a neutral measured-versus-labeled axis.
beats.visualAction: Extend the axis marker across 100 percent and finish at 347 percent on the number.

beats.narration: This came from laboratory testing of twenty-five U.S. melatonin gummy products, published in JAMA in twenty twenty-three.
beats.visualPurpose: Ground the striking result in its study type, sample size, location, and age.
beats.visualAction: Reveal a clean journal-style source annotation when JAMA is spoken.

beats.narration: That's a small sample from twenty twenty-three. It does not tell us what's in every gummy sold today.
beats.onScreenText:
IMPORTANT LIMITATION
SMALL 2023 SAMPLE ≠ EVERY BRAND TODAY
beats.visualPurpose: Visually interrupt overgeneralization with an explicit uncertainty pivot.
beats.visualAction: Collapse the sample grid into a small window rather than implying all products.

beats.narration: The practical takeaway? Look for independent product testing, and keep gummies safely out of children's reach.
beats.onScreenText:
WHAT TO DO
LOOK FOR INDEPENDENT TESTING
KEEP AWAY FROM CHILDREN
beats.visualPurpose: Give actionable quality and child-safety guidance without implying the study tested current products.
beats.visualAction: Reveal an independent-test seal silhouette and a child-resistant storage icon at their corresponding words.

beats.narration: More evidence, less hype. Follow The Hippie Scientist.
beats.visualPurpose: Memorable brand-signature close without adding another scientific claim.
beats.visualAction: Bring the THS wordmark into focus precisely on the name.

beats.visualPurpose: Hold the exact DOI visibly long enough for screenshot or pause.
beats.visualAction: Stationary large legible DOI plus JAMA citation held for a real three-second read.
